about: One worked Perfect Clear per live class of every ranked board of docs/tst-openers.html (the residue and leftover of the class): the first bag-3 deal, in a fixed permutation order, the solver clears. There is no bag-4 example: the T-placed page counts bag 3 only (schema /2 of this artefact drops the `b4` the solver binary still computes). An example, not a figure: the percentages come from analysis/tst-openers-tp.json. Plans are the solver's (engine movegen); a plan's cells are in the board as it stands at that step.
